paper.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
paper.data: Twelve VLAs on SimplerEnv plus WAM, real-robot and frozen-backbone analyses.
paper.method: Training-free neighborhood-overlap metric compares sensory representation geometry with end-effector trajectory geometry.
paper.task: Offline screening and diagnosis of embodied policies and candidate backbones.
paper.novelty: Introduces sensorimotor alignment as an inexpensive representation-level proxy for closed-loop success.
paper.project_relevance: A direct pre-rollout validator for prioritizing VLA/WAM baselines and backbone candidates.

paper.title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
paper.data: IntPhys2 plus new interval annotations for solidity, permanence, immutability and continuity.
paper.method: History-conditioned expected events are aligned with overlapping observed video windows to localize violations.
paper.task: Temporal localization and explanation of physical-consistency failures in generated video.
paper.novelty: Moves beyond scalar plausibility to time-localized, interpretable physical violations and releases annotations/code.
paper.project_relevance: A direct validator for generated world-model rollouts and reconstruction trajectories.

paper.title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
paper.data: 800 benchmark videos from 8 corpora/10 generators and 12,351 training videos with human-verified scores.
paper.method: Benchmark plus a 9B MLLM judge trained with supervised learning and reinforcement learning.
paper.task: Judge physical adherence and instruction alignment of generated embodied videos.
paper.novelty: Systematically validates judge-human agreement for embodied rollouts and releases a specialized training/evaluation bundle.
paper.project_relevance: A direct automated evaluator for candidate embodied-video/world-model rollouts.

lifecycle_changes.reason: First released metric in this narrowly defined offline screening task; current only for its validated SimplerEnv/model-family scope.
Adds temporal physical-violation localization and released timing labels; does not supersede distribution-calibration benchmarks.
Adds human-validated judging of embodied generated videos; complementary to physics-ground-truth and distribution metrics.
